metric_interpretation.performance_diff_in: Legacy hypot(total,int) composite, not an established flare bound or verified Radical formula.
metric_interpretation.effective_flare_diff_in: Legacy composite multiplied by normalized axis misalignment; uncalibrated comparison only.
metric_interpretation.flare_utilization_pct: Legacy name for 100 times normalized axis misalignment; NOT percentage of actual flare.
metric_interpretation.normalized_axis_misalignment: 2 norm(u cross Iu)/(Imax-Imin); dimensionless instantaneous diagnostic.
metric_interpretation.torque_free_axis_rate_per_spin: norm(du/dt)/norm(omega) under zero external torque; not a lane prediction.
